records.plant_name: Amazon Frederick Data Center power station
records.question: Is the Amazon data center at 3250 Digital Drive in Frederick already under construction or running?
records.finding: The state approved the air permit in March 2026, and I found no report from Amazon, Rowan, Frederick County or the press that work has started. A data center listing site, Baxtel, marks the Amazon building BWI-151 at Rowan's Frederick 1B as fully operational in 2026, but it gives no source.
records.recommendation: Enter the plant as pre-construction, and change it to construction or operating when a county building permit, an owner statement or a news report shows work under way.
records.researcher_notes: Baxtel is a lead only. Its listing does not say when the building opened or where the status comes from. A Frederick County building permit or occupancy record for 3250 Digital Drive would settle it.

verifications.note: State news release of March 25, 2026 announcing the approved air permit for Amazon Data Services at 3250 Digital Drive.
